messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks everyone for coming to today's all-hands — dropping a follow-up thread for any review/comp/benefits questions we didn't get to. We'll answer live here and collect for FAQs. Please keep each question short so we can triage. :raised_hands:

Marta (Eng): Quick Q on calibration — will managers get anonymized score distributions from other teams?

Aisha (People Ops): Short answer: yes, anonymized band distributions will be shared with manager leads during calibration week. Full per-team breakdowns are limited to SLT and People Ops for privacy. Link to notes: https://intranet.redwood/people/reviews-2026

Linus (SRE): If someone misses the promo window (e.g., new to role mid-cycle), can they be considered off-cycle or wait til next cycle?

Theo (People Ops): We support off-cycle promotions for significant role changes or missed calibration edge-cases. Manager should file an "off-cycle promo" request via the HR portal with a 1-paragraph justification + manager sign-off. People Ops and Finance will triage within 30 days.

Devon (Manager): For managers: are there changes to how totals affect comp pools this year? I'm seeing different guidance from my director.

Jamal (Finance): We updated pool guidance — emphasis on merit over across-the-board increases. Your director should have the pool allocation PDF. If not, ping me and I'll share the spreadsheet. Major point: no change to headcount pool rules for this FY.

Samir (Recruiting): Quick: do hires at levels that overlap with internal bands impact internal promotion timelines? Asking for candidate leveling conversations.

Aisha (People Ops): External offers/hiring doesn't lock internal timelines. We expect managers to be transparent about leveling and career path. If hire case creates compression we can discuss compression adjustments during comp planning.

Marta (Eng): Parental leave — any update on top-up pay when paired with FMLA? Someone asked about partial top-up for ICs.

Theo (People Ops): Still the same policy this year: Redwood provides 12 weeks paid parental leave + 8 weeks top-up to reach 100% base for eligible employees. Exceptions for part-time or contractors are reviewed case-by-case. DM People Ops with employee name and planned dates and we'll confirm eligibility.

Linus (SRE): About retroactive pay we asked in town hall — can you clarify the criteria for retroactive raises if someone submitted evidence late?

Jamal (Finance): Retroactive adjustments are rare. Criteria: clear administrative error OR documented miss in calibration review. Manager submits evidence and we aim to resolve within one payroll cycle. If approved, retro pay covers back to the original effective date (not earlier).

Devon (Manager): Appeal process: if an IC thinks their outcome was unfair, what's the concrete steps?

Aisha (People Ops): Steps: 1) Discuss with manager, 2) If unresolved, escalate to "calibration appeal" with People Ops (form link in handbook), 3) People Ops will coordinate a review panel (manager + cross-functional leader). Aim: resolution within 45 days. Appeals are for process issues or missed context, not to re-run full comps.

Samir (Recruiting): Any changes to leveling docs? I want to reference the canonical rubric in candidate interviews.

PeopleOpsBot: Updated rubric uploaded by Aisha — /handbook/leveling-rubric-v3 (last edited 1763456700).

Marta (Eng): Will there be more manager calibration training? Some new managers asked for a short workshop.

Theo (People Ops): Yes — we have two 60-min calibration workshops next week (Tue/Thu). RSVP link in the all-hands follow-up email. Attendance strongly encouraged for people managers.

Linus (SRE): Last one, apologies — bonuses: will payout timing shift if someone changes from individual contributor to manager mid-year?

Jamal (Finance): Bonus eligibility follows role on the payout date. If title change occurs before the payout date, they follow manager plan, otherwise IC plan. Managers should notify payroll immediately after title change to avoid delays.

Aisha (People Ops): Thanks for the questions — we'll compile an FAQ and post in the all-hands folder. If you have a confidential case, DM Theo or me. Closing with the doc again: https://intranet.redwood/people/reviews-2026#faq :thumbsup:

Marta (Eng): Thanks, useful.

Devon (Manager): Appreciate the clear timelines.

Linus (SRE): :thumbsup:

PeopleOpsBot: Thread marked answered.
